commands.description: Control inverter power state - 0xDE: Standby, 0xBE: PowerOn
Enable or disable off-grid output - 0: Disable, 1: Enable
Set generator control mode - 0: Manual, 1: Auto
Trigger generator start - write 1 to start
Set TOU max charging power - write to 48101, 48103, 48105 together
Set TOU max discharging power - write to 48113, 48115, 48117 together
